item.title: League-leading Lady Demons home tonight vs. UTRGV
item.description: The Northwestern State women’s basketball team is off to its best start through 13 games since 2021-22, and another tough test awaits, as it welcomes UTRGV to Prather Coliseum tonight at 6:30. item.description: Vastly accomplished sportswriters New Orleans native Gil LeBreton and John James Marshall of Shreveport have been selected for the 2026 Distinguished Service Award in Sports Journalism from the Louisiana Sports Writers Association. item.title: Natchitoches Port truck dump, conveyor system reactivation boosts regional forestry supply chain
item.description: A major infrastructure upgrade at the Natchitoches Parish Port is giving new strength to Louisiana’s forestry economy, with the port’s rehabilitated truck dump and wood chip conveyor system now online and moving residual wood chips by rail to national buyers. item.title: NSU ELAB Kindergarten applications open for 2026–2027 school year
item.description: NSU Elementary Lab School (ELAB) is now accepting applications for kindergarten for the 2026–2027 school year. Children must be 5 years old by September 30, 2026 to be eligible. Applications must be submitted to the school by March 6, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Proof of address is required.
